check.n: English Wikipedia dates Narmer to c. 3100 BC.
check.n_zh: 英文维基百科称那尔迈约在前3100年。

check.n: English Wikipedia dates Hor-Aha to c. 3085 BC.
check.n_zh: 英文维基百科称荷尔-阿哈约在前3085年。

check.n: English Wikipedia: Djer mid 31st century BC, reigned about 40 years.
check.n_zh: 英文维基百科：哲尔约在前31世纪中叶，在位约40年。

check.n: English Wikipedia dates Djet to c. 2980 BC.
check.n_zh: 英文维基百科称杰特约在前2980年。

Egypt.name: Merneith
Egypt.note: Queen who probably ruled as regent for her son Den.
Egypt.note_zh: 王后，可能曾为儿子登摄政。

check.n: English Wikipedia: Qa'a reigned about 33 years at end of 30th century BC.
check.n_zh: 英文维基百科：卡阿在位约33年，约在前30世纪末。

people.name: Narmer
people.known_for: Pharaoh traditionally credited with uniting Upper and Lower Egypt, shown on the Narmer Palette.
people.known_for_zh: 传统上认为统一上下埃及的法老，其事迹见于纳尔迈调色板。

check.n: Narmer's birth and death years are unknown; he is dated only approximately (fl. c. 3100 BC) and chronologies vary.
check.n_zh: 那尔迈生卒年不详，仅能大致定于约前3100年，各年表不一。

people.name: Hor-Aha
people.known_for: Early pharaoh of the First Dynasty, often linked to the founding of Memphis.
people.known_for_zh: 第一王朝早期的法老，常被认为与孟菲斯的建立有关。

people.name: Djer
people.known_for: First Dynasty pharaoh whose tomb at Abydos was later venerated as the tomb of Osiris.
people.known_for_zh: 第一王朝法老，他在阿拜多斯的陵墓后来被当作奥西里斯之墓来崇拜。

people.name: Merneith
people.known_for: Queen who may have ruled Egypt as regent, the first woman possibly to hold such power.
people.known_for_zh: 可能曾以摄政身份统治埃及的王后，或许是第一位掌握这种权力的女性。

people.name: Den
people.known_for: First Dynasty pharaoh who first used the title King of Upper and Lower Egypt.
people.known_for_zh: 第一王朝法老，最早使用“上下埃及之王”的称号。

people.name: Qa'a
people.known_for: Last king of the First Dynasty, buried in the last tomb with human sacrifices at Abydos.
people.known_for_zh: 第一王朝末代国王，他在阿拜多斯的陵墓是最后一座有人殉的王陵。

people.name: Peribsen
people.known_for: Second Dynasty king who placed the god Set rather than Horus above his name.
people.known_for_zh: 第二王朝国王，在王名上方用塞特神而不是荷鲁斯神的形象。

people.name: Khasekhemwy
people.known_for: Last king of the Second Dynasty who reunited Egypt and built great mud-brick enclosures.
people.known_for_zh: 第二王朝末代国王，重新统一埃及，修建大型泥砖围墙建筑。

people.name: Imhotep
people.known_for: Vizier of Djoser who designed the Step Pyramid, later worshipped as a god of medicine.
people.known_for_zh: 左塞尔的宰相，设计了阶梯金字塔，后来被奉为医神。

people.name: Djoser
people.known_for: Third Dynasty pharaoh whose Step Pyramid at Saqqara is the oldest large stone building.
people.known_for_zh: 第三王朝法老，他在塞加拉的阶梯金字塔是最古老的大型石造建筑。

people.name: Sneferu
people.known_for: Founder of the Fourth Dynasty who built the first true pyramids at Dahshur.
people.known_for_zh: 第四王朝的建立者，在代赫舒尔建造了最早的真正金字塔。

people.name: Hetepheres I
people.known_for: Queen of Sneferu and mother of Khufu, whose burial furniture survives intact.
people.known_for_zh: 斯尼夫鲁的王后、胡夫的母亲，她的随葬家具完整保存至今。

people.name: Khufu
people.known_for: Pharaoh who built the Great Pyramid of Giza, the largest pyramid ever made.
people.known_for_zh: 建造吉萨大金字塔的法老，这是有史以来最大的金字塔。

people.name: Hemiunu
people.known_for: Vizier of Khufu thought to have been the architect of the Great Pyramid.
people.known_for_zh: 胡夫的宰相，被认为是大金字塔的建筑师。

people.name: Khafre
people.known_for: Pharaoh who built the second pyramid of Giza and probably the Great Sphinx.
people.known_for_zh: 建造吉萨第二大金字塔的法老，狮身人面像很可能也是他所建。

people.name: Menkaure
people.known_for: Builder of the third pyramid of Giza, known for fine statues of himself and his queen.
people.known_for_zh: 建造吉萨第三座金字塔的法老，留下了与王后在一起的精美雕像。

people.name: Ptahhotep
people.known_for: Vizier to whom the Maxims of Ptahhotep, an early book of wisdom, are attributed.
people.known_for_zh: 宰相，传说是早期箴言集《普塔霍特普箴言》的作者。

people.name: Unas
people.known_for: Last king of the Fifth Dynasty, whose pyramid holds the first Pyramid Texts.
people.known_for_zh: 第五王朝末代国王，他的金字塔内刻有最早的金字塔铭文。

people.name: Weni
people.known_for: Official of Pepi I whose tomb biography records campaigns into the Levant.
people.known_for_zh: 佩皮一世的官员，他墓中的自传记录了向西亚的远征。

people.name: Harkhuf
people.known_for: Governor of Elephantine who led expeditions deep into Nubia and brought back a dancing pygmy.
people.known_for_zh: 象岛总督，率队深入努比亚，带回一名会跳舞的侏儒。

people.name: Pepi II
people.known_for: Pharaoh with one of the longest reigns in history, after which the Old Kingdom collapsed.
people.known_for_zh: 历史上在位时间最长的法老之一，他死后古王国崩溃。

Egypt.name_zh: 埃及（底比斯第十一王朝）

Herakleopolis.name_zh: 赫拉克利奥波利斯王朝

check.n_zh: 中文维基给出约前2115年—前2103年。

people.name: Ankhtifi
people.known_for: Nomarch whose tomb inscriptions describe famine and war in a divided Egypt.
people.known_for_zh: 州长，他墓中的铭文描述了分裂时期埃及的饥荒和战乱。

people.name: Meryibre Khety
people.known_for: Founder of the Herakleopolitan dynasty that ruled northern Egypt.
people.known_for_zh: 赫拉克利奥波利斯王朝的建立者，统治埃及北部。

people.name: Mentuhotep I
people.known_for: Theban ruler honoured as ancestor of the Eleventh Dynasty.
people.known_for_zh: 底比斯统治者，被尊为第十一王朝的祖先。

people.name: Intef I
people.known_for: First Theban ruler to claim the title of king, challenging Herakleopolis.
people.known_for_zh: 第一位自称国王的底比斯统治者，挑战赫拉克利奥波利斯王朝。

people.name: Intef II
people.known_for: Theban king who ruled for about fifty years and pushed his realm north to Abydos.
people.known_for_zh: 底比斯国王，在位约五十年，把疆域向北推进到阿拜多斯。

people.name: Wahkare Khety
people.known_for: Herakleopolitan king, probably the father who speaks in the Instruction for Merikare.
people.known_for_zh: 赫拉克利奥波利斯国王，可能就是《对美里卡拉的教谕》中训诫儿子的父亲。

people.name: Intef III
people.known_for: Theban king who took Asyut, preparing the reunification of Egypt.
people.known_for_zh: 底比斯国王，攻占艾斯尤特，为统一埃及做准备。

people.name: Merikare
people.known_for: Herakleopolitan king to whom a famous text of royal advice is addressed.
people.known_for_zh: 赫拉克利奥波利斯国王，一篇著名的王家训诫文就是写给他的。

Egypt.name: Sobekhotep IV
Egypt.note: Notable king of the Thirteenth Dynasty, whose many kings are poorly known.
Egypt.note_zh: 第十三王朝较有名的国王，该王朝诸王多数事迹不详。

people.name: Mentuhotep II
people.known_for: Theban king who reunited Egypt and began the Middle Kingdom.
people.known_for_zh: 重新统一埃及、开创中王国的底比斯国王。

people.name: Amenemhat I
people.known_for: Vizier who became king, founded the Twelfth Dynasty and moved the capital to Itjtawy.
people.known_for_zh: 由宰相登上王位，建立第十二王朝，迁都伊塔威。

check.n: Wikipedia (zh) gives reign c. 1991-1962 BC; en gives no birth date.
check.n_zh: 中文维基载在位约前1991年—前1962年。

people.name: Senusret I
people.known_for: Pharaoh who conquered Lower Nubia and built the oldest standing obelisk at Heliopolis.
people.known_for_zh: 征服下努比亚的法老，在赫利奥波利斯建造了现存最古老的方尖碑。

people.name: Khnumhotep II
people.known_for: Nomarch at Beni Hasan whose painted tomb shows Asiatic traders arriving in Egypt.
people.known_for_zh: 贝尼哈桑的州长，他墓中的壁画描绘了亚洲商队进入埃及。

people.name: Djehutihotep
people.known_for: Nomarch whose tomb painting shows a giant statue being hauled on a sledge.
people.known_for_zh: 州长，他墓中的壁画描绘了用橇拖运巨大雕像的场面。

people.name: Senusret III
people.known_for: Powerful pharaoh who built forts in Nubia and curbed the power of the nomarchs.
people.known_for_zh: 强有力的法老，在努比亚修建要塞，削弱各州州长的权力。

people.name: Amenemhat III
people.known_for: Pharaoh who developed the Faiyum and built the pyramid complex at Hawara called the Labyrinth.
people.known_for_zh: 开发法尤姆地区的法老，在哈瓦拉修建被称为“迷宫”的金字塔建筑群。

people.name: Sobekneferu
people.known_for: First woman known for certain to have ruled Egypt as pharaoh.
people.known_for_zh: 可以确定的第一位以法老身份统治埃及的女性。

people.name: Sobekhotep IV
people.known_for: One of the best-known kings of the weak Thirteenth Dynasty.
people.known_for_zh: 实力衰弱的第十三王朝中最有名的国王之一。

Egypt.name_zh: 埃及（底比斯第十七王朝）

check.n: Wikipedia says he came to power in 1534 or 1541 BC.
check.n_zh: 维基称其于前1534年或前1541年即位。

people.name: Salitis
people.known_for: First Hyksos king, according to Manetho, ruling from Avaris in the delta.
people.known_for_zh: 据曼涅托记载，他是第一位喜克索斯国王，以三角洲的阿瓦里斯为都城。

people.name: Khyan
people.known_for: Hyksos king whose name appears on objects from Crete to Mesopotamia.
people.known_for_zh: 喜克索斯国王，带有他名字的器物从克里特到两河流域都有发现。

people.name: Apepi
people.known_for: Long-reigning Hyksos king who fought the Theban kings Seqenenre and Kamose.
people.known_for_zh: 长期在位的喜克索斯国王，与底比斯国王塞肯内拉和卡摩斯作战。

people.name: Ahmes
people.known_for: Scribe who copied the Rhind papyrus, the main source of Egyptian mathematics.
people.known_for_zh: 抄写莱因德纸草书的书吏，这部纸草书是了解埃及数学的主要资料。

people.name: Tetisheri
people.known_for: Matriarch of the Theban royal family that drove out the Hyksos.
people.known_for_zh: 驱逐喜克索斯人的底比斯王室的女家长。

people.name: Seqenenre Tao
people.known_for: Theban king who began the war against the Hyksos and died of battle wounds.
people.known_for_zh: 发动驱逐喜克索斯人战争的底比斯国王，死于战伤。

people.name: Ahhotep I
people.known_for: Queen who held Thebes together during the war against the Hyksos.
people.known_for_zh: 在抗击喜克索斯人的战争中维系底比斯的王后。

people.name: Kamose
people.known_for: Last Theban king of the Seventeenth Dynasty, who attacked the Hyksos and recorded it on stelae.
people.known_for_zh: 第十七王朝最后一位底比斯国王，进攻喜克索斯人并刻碑记功。

people.name: Khamudi
people.known_for: Last Hyksos king, defeated by Ahmose I.
people.known_for_zh: 最后一位喜克索斯国王，被雅赫摩斯一世击败。

Egypt.name: Hatshepsut
Egypt.note: Ruled as pharaoh alongside the young Thutmose III.
Egypt.note_zh: 与年幼的图特摩斯三世共治，自立为法老。

check.n: Wikipedia says Tausret died in 1188 BC (end of dynasty).
check.n_zh: 维基称塔瓦斯雷特卒于前1188年。

people.name: Ahmose I
people.known_for: Pharaoh who expelled the Hyksos and founded the New Kingdom.
people.known_for_zh: 驱逐喜克索斯人、开创新王国的法老。

people.name: Ahmose, son of Ebana
people.known_for: Soldier whose tomb biography is the main eyewitness account of the war against the Hyksos.
people.known_for_zh: 军人，他墓中的自传是驱逐喜克索斯人战争的主要亲历记录。

people.name: Ineni
people.known_for: Architect who built the first royal tomb in the Valley of the Kings for Thutmose I.
people.known_for_zh: 建筑师，为图特摩斯一世在帝王谷修建了第一座王陵。

people.name: Hatshepsut
people.known_for: Queen who ruled as pharaoh, built the temple at Deir el-Bahari and sent an expedition to Punt.
people.known_for_zh: 以法老身份统治的女王，修建代尔巴哈里神庙，派遣船队远航蓬特。

people.name: Senenmut
people.known_for: Architect and steward of Hatshepsut who oversaw her great temple.
people.known_for_zh: 哈特谢普苏特的建筑师和总管，主持修建她的神庙。

people.name: Thutmose III
people.known_for: Warrior pharaoh who led 17 campaigns and made Egypt's empire reach the Euphrates.
people.known_for_zh: 尚武的法老，率军远征17次，使埃及帝国的疆域达到幼发拉底河。

people.name: Rekhmire
people.known_for: Vizier whose tomb paintings show the duties of office and the work of craftsmen.
people.known_for_zh: 宰相，他墓中的壁画描绘了宰相的职责和工匠的劳作。

people.name: Amenhotep, son of Hapu
people.known_for: Architect and scribe of Amenhotep III, later worshipped as a sage.
people.known_for_zh: 阿蒙霍特普三世的建筑师和书吏，后世被奉为圣贤。

people.name: Amenhotep III
people.known_for: Pharaoh at the peak of Egyptian wealth, builder of Luxor Temple and the Colossi of Memnon.
people.known_for_zh: 埃及最富强时期的法老，修建卢克索神庙和门农巨像。

people.name: Tiye
people.known_for: Influential queen of Amenhotep III and mother of Akhenaten.
people.known_for_zh: 阿蒙霍特普三世的王后、埃赫那吞的母亲，很有政治影响力。

people.name: Akhenaten
people.known_for: Pharaoh who promoted worship of the sun disc Aten and built a new capital at Amarna.
people.known_for_zh: 推行崇拜太阳神阿吞的宗教改革并在阿马尔奈建立新都的法老。

people.name: Nefertiti
people.known_for: Queen of Akhenaten, famous for her painted bust in Berlin.
people.known_for_zh: 埃赫那吞的王后，以收藏在柏林的彩绘胸像闻名。

people.name: Thutmose
people.known_for: Royal sculptor at Amarna whose workshop held the bust of Nefertiti.
people.known_for_zh: 阿马尔奈的宫廷雕刻家，娜芙蒂蒂胸像就出自他的作坊。

people.name: Tutankhamun
people.known_for: Boy king who restored the old gods; his nearly intact tomb was found in 1922.
people.known_for_zh: 少年法老，恢复了旧神崇拜，他几乎完好的陵墓于1922年被发现。

people.name: Horemheb
people.known_for: General who became the last king of the Eighteenth Dynasty and restored order.
people.known_for_zh: 由将军登上王位，第十八王朝末代国王，整顿国内秩序。

people.name: Seti I
people.known_for: Pharaoh who regained lands in Syria and built the fine temple at Abydos.
people.known_for_zh: 收复叙利亚失地的法老，在阿拜多斯修建了精美的神庙。

people.name: Ramesses II
people.known_for: Pharaoh who fought the Hittites at Kadesh, made peace with them and built Abu Simbel.
people.known_for_zh: 在卡迭石与赫梯作战、后与赫梯缔结和约的法老，修建了阿布辛拜勒神庙。

people.name: Nefertari
people.known_for: Great royal wife of Ramesses II, whose tomb has the finest paintings in the Valley of the Queens.
people.known_for_zh: 拉美西斯二世的正妻，她的陵墓壁画是王后谷中最精美的。

people.name: Merneptah
people.known_for: Pharaoh whose victory stele contains the earliest known mention of Israel.
people.known_for_zh: 法老，他的胜利石碑上有关于以色列的已知最早记载。

people.name: Ramesses III
people.known_for: Last great New Kingdom pharaoh, who defeated the Sea Peoples and was killed in a harem plot.
people.known_for_zh: 新王国最后一位强大的法老，击败海上民族，死于后宫阴谋。

维基载在位约前872年—前837年。

Egypt.name: Tefnakht
Egypt.note: Prince of Sais who led the north against Piye.
Egypt.note_zh: 塞易斯王公，率领北方诸侯对抗皮耶。

Kush.name: Piye
Kush.note: Conquered Egypt and founded the Twenty-fifth Dynasty.
Kush.note_zh: 征服埃及，建立第二十五王朝。

check.n: Wikipedia (en) gives 744-714 BC; zh says died c. 721 BC.
check.n_zh: 英文维基载前744年—前714年；中文载约前721年卒。

people.name: Smendes
people.known_for: Founder of the Twenty-first Dynasty who ruled from Tanis in the delta.
people.known_for_zh: 第二十一王朝的建立者，以三角洲的塔尼斯为都城。

people.name: Pinedjem I
people.known_for: High Priest of Amun who ruled southern Egypt from Thebes and reburied the royal mummies.
people.known_for_zh: 阿蒙大祭司，从底比斯统治埃及南部，重新安葬了历代法老的木乃伊。

people.name: Psusennes I
people.known_for: Pharaoh at Tanis whose unrobbed tomb held a silver coffin and gold mask.
people.known_for_zh: 塔尼斯的法老，他未被盗的陵墓中有银棺和黄金面具。

people.name: Shoshenq I
people.known_for: Libyan pharaoh, the Shishak of the Bible, who campaigned in Judah and Israel.
people.known_for_zh: 利比亚裔法老，即《圣经》中的示撒，曾远征犹大和以色列。

people.name: Osorkon II
people.known_for: Libyan pharaoh who sent troops to fight Assyria at Qarqar.
people.known_for_zh: 利比亚裔法老，派兵参加卡尔卡尔战役对抗亚述。

people.name: Karomama
people.known_for: God's Wife of Amun, known for a famous bronze statue inlaid with gold.
people.known_for_zh: 阿蒙神妻，以一尊镶金青铜雕像闻名。

people.name: Dido
people.known_for: Legendary Phoenician princess from Tyre said to have founded Carthage around 814 BC.
people.known_for_zh: 传说中来自推罗的腓尼基公主，相传于公元前814年前后建立迦太基城。

people.name: Tefnakht
people.known_for: Prince of Sais who united the north against the Kushite king Piye.
people.known_for_zh: 塞易斯王公，联合北方诸侯对抗库施国王皮耶。

people.name: Piye
people.known_for: Kushite king who conquered Egypt and told the story on his great victory stele.
people.known_for_zh: 征服埃及的库施国王，在胜利石碑上记述了这次征战。

people.name: Amenirdis I
people.known_for: Kushite princess installed as God's Wife of Amun at Thebes.
people.known_for_zh: 库施公主，被立为底比斯的阿蒙神妻。

people.name: Shabaka
people.known_for: Kushite pharaoh who had an ancient theological text copied onto the Shabaka Stone.
people.known_for_zh: 库施裔法老，命人把一篇古老神学文献刻在沙巴卡石上。

people.name: Taharqa
people.known_for: Kushite pharaoh who built across Egypt and Nubia but was driven out by Assyria.
people.known_for_zh: 库施裔法老，在埃及和努比亚大兴土木，后被亚述赶出埃及。

people.name: Montuemhat
people.known_for: Mayor of Thebes who governed Upper Egypt through the Kushite and Assyrian wars.
people.known_for_zh: 底比斯市长，在库施与亚述的战争期间治理上埃及。

people.name: Psamtik I
people.known_for: Founder of the Saite dynasty who freed Egypt from Assyria and reunited it.
people.known_for_zh: 赛斯王朝的建立者，使埃及摆脱亚述控制并重新统一。

people.name: Nitocris I
people.known_for: Daughter of Psamtik I installed as God's Wife of Amun, securing Thebes for her father.
people.known_for_zh: 普萨美提克一世之女，被立为阿蒙神妻，为父亲控制了底比斯。

people.name: Necho II
people.known_for: Pharaoh who began a canal from the Nile to the Red Sea and sent Phoenicians around Africa.
people.known_for_zh: 法老，开凿连接尼罗河与红海的运河，并派腓尼基人环航非洲。

people.name: Apries
people.known_for: Pharaoh who opposed Babylon in Judah and was overthrown by his general Amasis.
people.known_for_zh: 在犹大地区对抗巴比伦的法老，后被将军阿玛西斯推翻。

people.name: Amasis II
people.known_for: Pharaoh who welcomed Greek traders at Naucratis and kept Egypt prosperous.
people.known_for_zh: 法老，允许希腊商人在瑙克拉提斯定居经商，使埃及保持繁荣。

people.name: Mago I
people.known_for: Carthaginian leader whose family built Carthage's power in the western Mediterranean.
people.known_for_zh: 迦太基领袖，他的家族使迦太基成为西地中海的强国。

people.name: Udjahorresnet
people.known_for: Egyptian admiral and physician who served the Persian kings Cambyses and Darius.
people.known_for_zh: 埃及海军将领和医生，曾为波斯国王冈比西斯和大流士效力。

people.name: Hanno the Navigator
people.known_for: Carthaginian who sailed down the west coast of Africa and left a famous account.
people.known_for_zh: 迦太基航海家，沿非洲西海岸南航，留下著名的航行记。

people.name: Himilco
people.known_for: Carthaginian navigator who explored the Atlantic coast of Europe.
people.known_for_zh: 迦太基航海家，探索了欧洲大西洋沿岸。

people.name: Amyrtaeus
people.known_for: Prince of Sais who led the revolt that freed Egypt from Persia in 404 BC.
people.known_for_zh: 塞易斯王公，领导起义，于公元前404年使埃及摆脱波斯统治。

people.name: Nectanebo I
people.known_for: Founder of the Thirtieth Dynasty who repelled a Persian invasion and built many temples.
people.known_for_zh: 第三十王朝的建立者，击退波斯入侵，修建许多神庙。

people.name: Nectanebo II
people.known_for: Last native pharaoh of Egypt, defeated by the Persians in 342 BC.
people.known_for_zh: 埃及最后一位本土法老，公元前342年被波斯击败。

people.name: Petosiris
people.known_for: High priest of Thoth whose tomb mixes Egyptian and Greek art.
people.known_for_zh: 托特神大祭司，他的墓葬艺术融合了埃及和希腊风格。

Ptolemaic Kingdom.name: Ptolemy I Soter
Ptolemaic Kingdom.note: Satrap of Egypt from 323 BC, king from 305 BC.
Ptolemaic Kingdom.note_zh: 公元前323年起任埃及总督，公元前305年称王。

people.name: Ptolemy I Soter
people.known_for: General of Alexander who took Egypt, founded the Ptolemaic dynasty and the Museum of Alexandria.
people.known_for_zh: 亚历山大的部将，占据埃及，建立托勒密王朝和亚历山大博学园。

people.name: Demetrius of Phalerum
people.known_for: Athenian statesman said to have advised Ptolemy I to found the Library of Alexandria.
people.known_for_zh: 雅典政治家，据说是他建议托勒密一世创建亚历山大图书馆。

people.name: Manetho
people.known_for: Egyptian priest whose history in Greek divided the pharaohs into the thirty dynasties still used today.
people.known_for_zh: 埃及祭司，用希腊文写成埃及史，把法老划分为至今沿用的三十个王朝。

people.name: Ptolemy II Philadelphus
people.known_for: King under whom the Library and the Pharos lighthouse were completed and the Septuagint was begun.
people.known_for_zh: 在他统治时亚历山大图书馆和灯塔建成，《七十士译本》开始翻译。

people.name: Arsinoe II
people.known_for: Queen who married her brother Ptolemy II and was worshipped as a goddess.
people.known_for_zh: 嫁给弟弟托勒密二世的王后，生前即被奉为女神。

people.name: Ctesibius
people.known_for: Inventor of the force pump, the water organ and an improved water clock.
people.known_for_zh: 发明家，发明了压力泵、水风琴，并改进了水钟。

people.name: Apollonius of Rhodes
people.name_zh: 罗德岛的阿波罗尼奥斯
people.known_for: Librarian of Alexandria and author of the epic Argonautica.
people.known_for_zh: 亚历山大图书馆馆长，著有史诗《阿尔戈英雄纪》。

people.name: Erasistratus
people.known_for: Physician who studied the heart, veins and nerves by dissection.
people.known_for_zh: 医学家，通过解剖研究心脏、血管和神经。

people.name: Berenice II
people.known_for: Queen of Ptolemy III whose dedicated hair gave its name to the constellation Coma Berenices.
people.known_for_zh: 托勒密三世的王后，她献给神庙的头发成为后发座名称的来源。

people.name: Aristarchus of Samothrace
people.name_zh: 萨莫色雷斯的阿里斯塔克斯
people.known_for: Head of the Library who edited the texts of Homer.
people.known_for_zh: 亚历山大图书馆馆长，校订了荷马史诗。

people.name: Masinissa
people.known_for: First king of united Numidia, who helped Rome defeat Carthage at Zama.
people.known_for_zh: 统一努米底亚的第一位国王，帮助罗马在扎马战役中击败迦太基。

people.name: Mago
people.known_for: Carthaginian writer whose great work on farming was translated into Latin by order of the Roman Senate.
people.known_for_zh: 迦太基作家，他的农学巨著经罗马元老院下令译成拉丁文。

people.name: Hasdrubal the Boeotarch
people.known_for: General who commanded Carthage in its last war and surrendered when Rome destroyed the city in 146 BC.
people.known_for_zh: 迦太基最后一战的统帅，公元前146年罗马毁城时投降。

people.name: Jugurtha
people.known_for: King of Numidia who long resisted Rome, as told by Sallust.
people.known_for_zh: 长期抵抗罗马的努米底亚国王，萨卢斯特为此写了专著。

people.name: Juba I of Numidia
people.known_for: King of Numidia who sided with Pompey against Caesar and died after Thapsus.
people.known_for_zh: 努米底亚国王，在内战中支持庞培对抗恺撒，塔普苏斯战役后自杀。

people.name: Juba II
people.place_zh: 毛里塔尼亚的恺撒利亚
people.known_for: Scholar king of Mauretania and husband of Cleopatra's daughter, author of many books.
people.known_for_zh: 毛里塔尼亚的学者国王，娶克娄巴特拉之女为妻，著述甚多。

people.name: Philo
people.known_for: Jewish philosopher of Alexandria who explained the Bible through Greek philosophy.
people.known_for_zh: 亚历山大的犹太哲学家，用希腊哲学诠释《圣经》。

people.name: Mark the Evangelist
people.known_for: Traditional author of the Gospel of Mark and founder of the church of Alexandria.
people.known_for_zh: 传统上认为是《马可福音》的作者和亚历山大教会的创始人。

people.name: Hero of Alexandria
people.known_for: Engineer who described a steam-driven engine and many automatic devices.
people.known_for_zh: 工程师，描述了蒸汽驱动的汽转球和许多自动装置。

people.name: Valentinus
people.known_for: Gnostic teacher from Egypt with a wide following in the early church.
people.known_for_zh: 来自埃及的诺斯替派导师，在早期教会中追随者众多。

people.name: Apuleius
people.known_for: North African writer of The Golden Ass, the only complete Latin novel to survive.
people.known_for_zh: 北非作家，著有《金驴记》，这是唯一完整保存下来的拉丁文小说。

people.name: Clement of Alexandria
people.known_for: Christian teacher who joined Greek learning with the faith.
people.known_for_zh: 基督教导师，把希腊学术与信仰结合起来。

people.name: Septimius Severus
people.known_for: Emperor born at Leptis Magna, the first Roman emperor from Africa.
people.known_for_zh: 出生于大莱普提斯的皇帝，是第一位来自非洲的罗马皇帝。

people.name: Perpetua
people.known_for: Young Christian martyr of Carthage whose prison diary is one of the earliest texts by a woman.
people.known_for_zh: 迦太基的年轻基督教殉道者，她的狱中日记是最早出自女性之手的文献之一。

people.name: Origen
people.known_for: Greatest scholar of the early church, who compared versions of the Bible in his Hexapla.
people.known_for_zh: 早期教会最伟大的学者，编订《六文本合参》对照各种版本的《圣经》。

people.name: Ammonius Saccas
people.known_for: Philosopher of Alexandria, teacher of Plotinus and founder of Neoplatonism.
people.known_for_zh: 亚历山大的哲学家，普罗提诺的老师，被视为新柏拉图主义的开创者。

people.name: Cyprian
people.known_for: Bishop of Carthage martyred under Valerian, a leading writer of the Latin church.
people.known_for_zh: 迦太基主教，在瓦勒良迫害中殉道，是拉丁教会的重要作家。

people.name: Anthony the Great
people.known_for: Egyptian hermit called the father of Christian monasticism.
people.known_for_zh: 埃及隐修士，被称为基督教修道主义之父。

people.name: Pachomius the Great
people.known_for: Founder of communal monasteries in Upper Egypt.
people.known_for_zh: 在上埃及创立集体修道院制度的人。

people.name: Pappus of Alexandria
people.known_for: Last great Greek geometer, whose Collection preserves much older mathematics.
people.known_for_zh: 最后一位伟大的希腊几何学家，他的《数学汇编》保存了许多早期数学成果。

people.name: Didymus the Blind
people.known_for: Blind theologian who headed the catechetical school of Alexandria.
people.known_for_zh: 双目失明的神学家，主持亚历山大教理学校。

people.name: Theophilus of Alexandria
people.known_for: Patriarch of Alexandria under whom the Serapeum temple was destroyed in 391.
people.known_for_zh: 亚历山大牧首，391年塞拉皮斯神庙在他主持下被毁。

people.name: Shenoute
people.known_for: Abbot of the White Monastery and the greatest writer in Coptic.
people.known_for_zh: 白修道院院长，最伟大的科普特语作家。

people.name: Synesius
people.known_for: Student of Hypatia and bishop of Ptolemais whose letters describe Cyrenaica.
people.known_for_zh: 希帕提娅的学生，托勒迈斯主教，他的书信描写了昔兰尼加的情况。

people.name: Cyril of Alexandria
people.known_for: Patriarch who led the condemnation of Nestorius at the Council of Ephesus in 431.
people.known_for_zh: 亚历山大牧首，在431年以弗所会议上主导谴责聂斯脱里。

people.name: Nonnus
people.known_for: Egyptian Greek poet of the Dionysiaca, the longest surviving ancient epic.
people.known_for_zh: 埃及希腊语诗人，著有现存最长的古代史诗《狄俄尼索斯纪》。

people.name: Dioscorus I of Alexandria
people.name_zh: 亚历山大的狄奥斯库若一世
people.known_for: Patriarch deposed at Chalcedon in 451, revered by the Coptic Church.
people.known_for_zh: 在451年卡尔西顿会议上被废黜的亚历山大牧首，受科普特教会尊崇。

people.name: Fulgentius of Ruspe
people.name_zh: 鲁斯佩的富尔根提乌斯
people.known_for: North African bishop and theologian who opposed the Arian Vandal kings.
people.known_for_zh: 北非主教和神学家，反对信奉阿里乌派的汪达尔国王。

people.name: John Philoponus
people.known_for: Philosopher who criticised Aristotle's physics and anticipated the idea of impetus.
people.known_for_zh: 哲学家，批评亚里士多德的物理学，提出了冲力理论的雏形。

people.name: Olympiodorus the Younger
people.known_for: Last pagan head of the philosophy school of Alexandria.
people.known_for_zh: 亚历山大哲学学校最后一位异教徒主持人。

people.name: Cosmas Indicopleustes
people.known_for: Merchant who sailed to India and wrote a Christian Topography describing Sri Lanka and its trade.
people.known_for_zh: 航行到印度的商人，在《基督教地形学》中描述了斯里兰卡及其贸易。

people.name: Gelimer
people.known_for: Last king of the Vandals, defeated by Belisarius.
people.known_for_zh: 汪达尔王国的末代国王，被贝利撒留击败。

people.name: Corippus
people.known_for: Latin poet of North Africa who wrote an epic of Byzantine wars against the Berbers.
people.known_for_zh: 北非拉丁语诗人，写了记述拜占庭与柏柏尔人战争的史诗。

people.name: Cyrus of Alexandria
people.known_for: Patriarch and governor of Egypt who surrendered Alexandria to the Arabs.
people.known_for_zh: 亚历山大牧首兼埃及总督，向阿拉伯人交出亚历山大城。

people.name: Amr ibn al-As
people.known_for: Arab general who conquered Egypt in 640 to 642 and founded Fustat.
people.known_for_zh: 阿拉伯将领，640年至642年征服埃及，建立福斯塔特城。

people.name: Uqba ibn Nafi
people.known_for: General who led the conquest of the Maghreb and founded Kairouan in 670.
people.known_for_zh: 率军征服马格里布的将领，670年建立凯鲁万城。

people.name: Dihya
people.known_for: Berber queen, known as al-Kahina, who led resistance to the Arab conquest.
people.known_for_zh: 柏柏尔女王，人称“卡希娜”，领导抵抗阿拉伯人的征服。

people.name: Musa ibn Nusayr
people.known_for: Governor of Ifriqiya who completed the conquest of the Maghreb and sent Tariq into Spain.
people.known_for_zh: 伊夫里基亚总督，完成征服马格里布，派塔里克进军西班牙。

people.name: Al-Layth ibn Sa'd
people.known_for: Leading jurist of Egypt, admired by al-Shafi'i.
people.known_for_zh: 埃及首屈一指的法学家，受到沙斐仪的推崇。

people.name: Idris I
people.known_for: Descendant of Ali who fled the Abbasids and founded the Idrisid state in Morocco.
people.known_for_zh: 阿里的后裔，躲避阿拔斯王朝迫害，在摩洛哥建立伊德里斯王朝。

people.name: Asad ibn al-Furat
people.known_for: Jurist of Kairouan who led the Aghlabid invasion of Sicily in 827.
people.known_for_zh: 凯鲁万的法学家，827年率领阿格拉布军队进攻西西里。

people.name: Idris II
people.known_for: Idrisid ruler who made Fez his capital.
people.known_for_zh: 伊德里斯王朝统治者，定都非斯。

people.name: Sahnun
people.known_for: Jurist of Kairouan whose Mudawwana made the Maliki school dominant in North Africa.
people.known_for_zh: 凯鲁万的法学家，他的《穆德瓦纳》使马立克学派在北非占据主导地位。

people.name: Dhul-Nun al-Misri
people.known_for: Egyptian Sufi who taught the idea of mystical knowledge of God.
people.known_for_zh: 埃及的苏非，提出对真主的神秘体认。

people.name: Ibn Hisham
people.known_for: Scholar in Fustat who edited the standard biography of Muhammad.
people.known_for_zh: 在福斯塔特的学者，编订了穆罕默德的标准传记。

people.name: Fatima al-Fihri
people.known_for: Woman who founded the al-Qarawiyyin mosque in Fez in 859, later a famous university.
people.known_for_zh: 859年在非斯创建卡鲁因清真寺的女性，该寺后来成为著名学府。

people.name: Ibn Abd al-Hakam
people.known_for: Historian whose book on the conquest of Egypt and the Maghreb is the oldest surviving account.
people.known_for_zh: 历史学家，他记述征服埃及和马格里布的著作是现存最早的记载。

people.name: Ahmad ibn Tulun
people.known_for: Turkic governor who made Egypt independent of Baghdad and built the great mosque that bears his name.
people.known_for_zh: 突厥裔总督，使埃及脱离巴格达而独立，修建以他命名的大清真寺。

people.name: Abu Kamil
people.known_for: Egyptian mathematician who extended the algebra of al-Khwarizmi.
people.known_for_zh: 埃及数学家，发展了花拉子米的代数学。

people.name: Isaac Israeli ben Solomon
people.known_for: Jewish physician of Kairouan whose medical books were read in medieval Europe.
people.known_for_zh: 凯鲁万的犹太医生，他的医学著作在中世纪欧洲广为流传。

people.name: Khumarawayh
people.known_for: Son of Ibn Tulun, famed for his luxury and the huge dowry of his daughter.
people.known_for_zh: 伊本·图伦之子，以奢华著称，嫁女时陪嫁极其丰厚。

people.name: Ibrahim II of Ifriqiya
people.known_for: Aghlabid emir who completed the conquest of Sicily and built the palace city of Raqqada.
people.known_for_zh: 阿格拉布埃米尔，完成征服西西里，修建拉卡达宫城。

people.name: Abu Abdallah al-Shi'i
people.known_for: Ismaili missionary who won over the Kutama Berbers and overthrew the Aghlabids.
people.known_for_zh: 伊斯玛仪派宣教士，争取到库塔马柏柏尔人支持，推翻了阿格拉布王朝。

people.name: Abdallah al-Mahdi Billah
people.known_for: Founder of the Fatimid Caliphate in 909 who built the city of Mahdia.
people.known_for_zh: 909年建立法蒂玛王朝的哈里发，修建马赫迪耶城。

people.name: Muhammad ibn Tughj al-Ikhshid
people.known_for: Governor who founded the Ikhshidid dynasty in Egypt.
people.known_for_zh: 在埃及建立伊赫什德王朝的总督。

people.name: Ibn al-Jazzar
people.known_for: Physician of Kairouan whose travellers' handbook was translated into Latin.
people.known_for_zh: 凯鲁万的医生，他的旅行者医学手册被译成拉丁文。

people.name: Muhammad ibn Yusuf al-Kindi
people.known_for: Historian of Egypt who wrote on its governors and judges.
people.known_for_zh: 埃及历史学家，著有埃及总督和法官的史书。

people.name: Al-Qadi al-Nu'man
people.known_for: Chief jurist of the Fatimids who wrote the basic book of Ismaili law.
people.known_for_zh: 法蒂玛王朝的首席法官，写下伊斯玛仪派教法的基本著作。

people.name: Abu Yazid
people.known_for: Kharijite Berber leader whose great revolt almost destroyed the Fatimid state.
people.known_for_zh: 哈瓦利吉派的柏柏尔领袖，他的大起义几乎摧毁法蒂玛政权。

people.name: Abu al-Misk Kafur
people.known_for: Former Nubian slave who ruled Egypt for over twenty years as regent and emir.
people.known_for_zh: 出身努比亚奴隶，以摄政和埃米尔身份统治埃及二十余年。

people.name: Jawhar al-Siqilli
people.known_for: Fatimid general who conquered Egypt in 969 and founded Cairo and al-Azhar.
people.known_for_zh: 法蒂玛王朝将领，969年征服埃及，建立开罗城和爱资哈尔清真寺。

check.n: Birth year unknown; Wikidata gives 911, other sources c. 928.
check.n_zh: 生年不详；维基数据作911年，另有约928年之说。

people.name: Ya'qub ibn Killis
people.known_for: Vizier who organised the Fatimid state in Egypt and made al-Azhar a place of teaching.
people.known_for_zh: 宰相，组建法蒂玛王朝在埃及的统治机构，使爱资哈尔成为讲学之所。

people.name: Al-Mu'izz li-Din Allah
people.known_for: Fatimid caliph who moved his court from Tunisia to the new city of Cairo.
people.known_for_zh: 法蒂玛王朝哈里发，把宫廷从突尼斯迁到新建的开罗。

people.name: Ibn Yunus
people.known_for: Astronomer of Cairo whose Hakimi tables were the most accurate of their time.
people.known_for_zh: 开罗天文学家，他编制的《哈基姆天文表》是当时最精确的。

people.name: Ibn al-Haytham
people.known_for: Scientist in Cairo whose Book of Optics founded the experimental study of light.
people.known_for_zh: 在开罗工作的科学家，他的《光学之书》开创了用实验研究光学的方法。

people.name: Al-Hakim bi-Amr Allah
people.known_for: Eccentric Fatimid caliph who founded the House of Knowledge; the Druze revere him.
people.known_for_zh: 行事怪异的法蒂玛王朝哈里发，创建知识宫，德鲁兹派尊奉他。

people.name: Ali ibn Ridwan
people.known_for: Chief physician of Egypt who described a supernova seen in 1006.
people.known_for_zh: 埃及首席医官，记录了1006年出现的超新星。

people.name: Ibn Rashiq
people.known_for: Poet and critic of Kairouan who wrote a classic book on the art of poetry.
people.known_for_zh: 凯鲁万的诗人和评论家，著有论诗歌艺术的经典之作。

people.name: Abdallah ibn Yasin
people.known_for: Preacher among the Sanhaja Berbers who founded the Almoravid movement.
people.known_for_zh: 在桑哈贾柏柏尔人中宣教，创立穆拉比特运动。

people.name: Badr al-Jamali
people.known_for: Armenian vizier who restored Fatimid power and rebuilt the walls and gates of Cairo.
people.known_for_zh: 亚美尼亚裔宰相，恢复法蒂玛王朝的权力，重建开罗城墙和城门。

people.name: Yusuf ibn Tashfin
people.known_for: Almoravid ruler who founded Marrakesh and defeated Castile at Sagrajas.
people.known_for_zh: 穆拉比特王朝统治者，建立马拉喀什城，在萨格拉哈斯战役中击败卡斯蒂利亚。

people.name: Zaynab an-Nafzawiyya
people.known_for: Wife and close adviser of Yusuf ibn Tashfin.
people.known_for_zh: 优素福·本·塔什芬的妻子和重要谋士。

people.name: Ibn Tumart
people.known_for: Berber reformer who proclaimed himself Mahdi and founded the Almohad movement.
people.known_for_zh: 柏柏尔改革家，自称马赫迪，创立穆瓦希德运动。

people.name: Muhammad al-Idrisi
people.known_for: Geographer from Ceuta who made a great world map for King Roger II of Sicily.
people.known_for_zh: 出生于休达的地理学家，为西西里国王罗杰二世绘制了世界地图。

people.name: Abd al-Mu'min
people.known_for: First Almohad caliph, who conquered Morocco, the Maghreb and al-Andalus.
people.known_for_zh: 第一位穆瓦希德哈里发，征服摩洛哥、马格里布和安达卢斯。

people.name: Saladin
people.known_for: Founder of the Ayyubid dynasty who ended the Fatimids and retook Jerusalem from the crusaders in 1187.
people.known_for_zh: 阿尤布王朝的建立者，结束法蒂玛王朝，1187年从十字军手中收复耶路撒冷。

people.name: Al-Qadi al-Fadil
people.known_for: Chancellor of Saladin, famous for his elegant letters.
people.known_for_zh: 萨拉丁的掌玺大臣，以文辞优美的书信著称。

people.name: Maimonides
people.known_for: Jewish philosopher and physician to Saladin's court, author of the Guide for the Perplexed.
people.known_for_zh: 犹太哲学家，萨拉丁宫廷的医生，著有《迷途指津》。

people.name: Abu Madyan
people.known_for: Andalusian Sufi master of Bejaia, patron saint of Tlemcen.
people.known_for_zh: 在贝贾亚传道的安达卢斯苏非大师，被尊为特莱姆森的守护圣人。

people.name: Abu Yusuf Yaqub al-Mansur
people.known_for: Almohad caliph who defeated Castile at Alarcos and built the Koutoubia minaret.
people.known_for_zh: 穆瓦希德哈里发，在阿拉科斯击败卡斯蒂利亚，修建库图比亚清真寺宣礼塔。

people.name: Abd al-Latif al-Baghdadi
people.name_zh: 阿卜杜勒·拉提夫·巴格达迪
people.known_for: Physician and scholar who wrote an eyewitness account of Egypt and its famine.
people.known_for_zh: 医生和学者，亲历并记述了埃及的风物和大饥荒。

people.name: Al-Adil I
people.known_for: Brother of Saladin who reunited the Ayyubid lands.
people.known_for_zh: 萨拉丁的弟弟，重新统一阿尤布王朝各领地。

people.name: Ibn Jubayr
people.known_for: Andalusian traveller whose account of his pilgrimage describes Egypt, Mecca and crusader Syria.
people.known_for_zh: 安达卢斯旅行家，他的朝觐游记描述了埃及、麦加和十字军治下的叙利亚。

people.name: Ibn al-Farid
people.known_for: Sufi poet of Cairo, the greatest mystical poet in Arabic.
people.known_for_zh: 开罗的苏非诗人，阿拉伯语中最伟大的神秘主义诗人。

people.name: Al-Kamil
people.known_for: Sultan who met Francis of Assisi and handed Jerusalem to Frederick II by treaty in 1229.
people.known_for_zh: 苏丹，曾会见阿西西的方济各，1229年以条约把耶路撒冷交给腓特烈二世。

people.name: Ibn al-Baitar
people.known_for: Andalusian botanist and chief herbalist of Egypt who catalogued 1,400 medicines.
people.known_for_zh: 安达卢斯植物学家，任埃及首席药草师，记载了1400种药物。

people.name: Abu al-Hasan al-Shadhili
people.known_for: Moroccan Sufi who founded the Shadhili order in Alexandria.
people.known_for_zh: 摩洛哥苏非，在亚历山大创立沙兹里教团。

people.name: Abu Zakariya Yahya
people.known_for: Founder of the Hafsid dynasty that ruled Tunis for three centuries.
people.known_for_zh: 哈夫斯王朝的建立者，该王朝统治突尼斯三百年。

Mamluke Sultanate.name: al-Nasir Muhammad
Mamluke Sultanate.note_zh: 此前还曾于1293年至1294年、1299年至1309年在位。

Morocco.name: Abd al-Haqq II
Morocco.note: Last Marinid sultan; the Wattasids took power in 1472.
Morocco.note_zh: 马林王朝末代苏丹，1472年瓦塔斯王朝掌权。

people.name: Shajar al-Durr
people.known_for: Widow of as-Salih Ayyub who ruled Egypt as sultana in 1250, opening the Mamluk era.
people.known_for_zh: 萨利赫·阿尤布的遗孀，1250年以女苏丹身份统治埃及，开启了马穆鲁克时代。

people.name: Qutuz
people.known_for: Mamluk sultan who defeated the Mongols at Ain Jalut in 1260.
people.known_for_zh: 马穆鲁克苏丹，1260年在艾因扎鲁特击败蒙古军。

people.name: Baybars
people.known_for: Mamluk sultan who fought at Ain Jalut, took crusader castles and built the Mamluk state.
people.known_for_zh: 马穆鲁克苏丹，参加艾因扎鲁特之战，攻取十字军城堡，奠定马穆鲁克国家的基础。

people.name: Ibn al-Nafis
people.known_for: Physician of Cairo who first described the circulation of blood through the lungs.
people.known_for_zh: 开罗的医生，最早描述了血液的肺循环。

works.title: Commentary on Anatomy in Avicenna's Canon

people.name: Qalawun
people.known_for: Mamluk sultan who built a great hospital in Cairo and took Tripoli from the crusaders.
people.known_for_zh: 马穆鲁克苏丹，在开罗修建大医院，从十字军手中夺取的黎波里。

people.name: Al-Busiri
people.known_for: Berber poet in Egypt whose Mantle Ode in praise of Muhammad is recited all over the Muslim world.
people.known_for_zh: 在埃及的柏柏尔诗人，他赞美先知的《斗篷颂》在整个伊斯兰世界传诵。

people.name: Ibn Manzur
people.known_for: Lexicographer who compiled the great Arabic dictionary Lisan al-Arab.
people.known_for_zh: 辞书编纂家，编成大型阿拉伯语词典《阿拉伯人的语言》。

people.name: Ibn al-Banna
people.known_for: Moroccan mathematician and astronomer of Marrakesh.
people.known_for_zh: 马拉喀什的摩洛哥数学家和天文学家。

people.name: Al-Nuwayri
people.known_for: Mamluk official who compiled a vast encyclopedia of knowledge.
people.known_for_zh: 马穆鲁克官员，编纂了一部大型百科全书。

people.name: Al-Nasir Muhammad
people.known_for: Mamluk sultan whose long third reign was the height of Cairo's wealth and building.
people.known_for_zh: 马穆鲁克苏丹，他第三次在位期间开罗的财富和建筑达到顶峰。

people.name: Ibn Arafa
people.known_for: Maliki jurist and imam of the great mosque of Tunis.
people.known_for_zh: 马立克派法学家，突尼斯大清真寺的伊玛目。

people.name: Abu Inan Faris
people.known_for: Marinid sultan who built madrasas in Fez and sponsored Ibn Battuta's book.
people.known_for_zh: 马林王朝苏丹，在非斯修建经学院，资助伊本·白图泰写书。

people.name: Ibn Khaldun
people.known_for: Historian born in Tunis whose Muqaddimah explains the rise and fall of dynasties.
people.known_for_zh: 出生于突尼斯的历史学家，他的《历史绪论》阐述了王朝兴衰的规律。

people.name: Al-Qalqashandi
people.known_for: Mamluk secretary who wrote an encyclopedia of chancery practice.
people.known_for_zh: 马穆鲁克书记官，写了一部关于公文写作的百科全书。

people.name: Al-Maqrizi
people.known_for: Historian of Egypt whose Khitat describes the topography and buildings of Cairo.
people.known_for_zh: 埃及历史学家，他的《埃及志》记述了开罗的地理和建筑。

people.name: Ibn Hajar al-Asqalani
people.known_for: Hadith scholar whose commentary on Sahih al-Bukhari is the standard one.
people.known_for_zh: 圣训学家，他对《布哈里圣训实录》的注释成为标准注本。

people.name: Ibn Taghribirdi
people.known_for: Historian of the Mamluk sultans.
people.known_for_zh: 马穆鲁克苏丹的史家。

people.name: Muhammad al-Jazuli
people.known_for: Moroccan Sufi whose prayer book Dala'il al-Khayrat is widely recited.
people.known_for_zh: 摩洛哥苏非，他的祈祷书《善行指南》广为诵读。

people.name: Qaitbay
people.known_for: Mamluk sultan who built the citadel of Alexandria and many fine buildings in Cairo.
people.known_for_zh: 马穆鲁克苏丹，修建亚历山大城堡和开罗的许多精美建筑。

people.name: Al-Suyuti
people.known_for: Prolific Egyptian scholar who wrote hundreds of works on religion, history and language.
people.known_for_zh: 著作等身的埃及学者，写下数百部宗教、历史和语言著作。

Morocco.name: Mohammed al-Shaykh
Morocco.note: First Saadi sultan of all Morocco.
Morocco.note_zh: 萨阿德王朝首位统一摩洛哥的苏丹。

people.name: Oruç Reis
people.known_for: Corsair who seized Algiers in 1516 and brought it under Ottoman protection.
people.known_for_zh: 海盗首领，1516年夺取阿尔及尔，使其归附奥斯曼帝国。

people.name: Hayreddin Barbarossa
people.known_for: Ruler of Algiers and Ottoman grand admiral who won the Battle of Preveza in 1538.
people.known_for_zh: 阿尔及尔统治者和奥斯曼海军元帅，1538年赢得普雷韦扎海战。

people.name: Leo Africanus
people.known_for: Moroccan diplomat captured by pirates whose Description of Africa informed Europe for centuries.
people.known_for_zh: 被海盗俘获的摩洛哥外交官，他的《非洲志》几百年间是欧洲了解非洲的主要依据。

people.name: Ahmad al-Mansur
people.known_for: Saadi sultan who defeated Portugal in 1578 and conquered the Songhai Empire.
people.known_for_zh: 萨阿德王朝苏丹，1578年击败葡萄牙，征服桑海帝国。

people.name: Al-Maqqari
people.known_for: Historian from Tlemcen who wrote the great history of al-Andalus.
people.known_for_zh: 来自特莱姆森的历史学家，写下了安达卢斯的大部头史书。

people.name: Al-Hasan al-Yusi
people.known_for: Moroccan scholar famous for his letter of advice to Sultan Ismail.
people.known_for_zh: 摩洛哥学者，以上书劝谏穆莱·伊斯梅尔苏丹著称。

people.name: Ismail Ibn Sharif
people.known_for: Alaouite sultan who built Meknes as an imperial city and ruled Morocco for 55 years.
people.known_for_zh: 阿拉维王朝苏丹，把梅克内斯建成帝都，统治摩洛哥55年。

people.name: Ali Bey al-Kabir
people.known_for: Mamluk leader who broke from the Ottomans and briefly ruled Egypt and Syria.
people.known_for_zh: 马穆鲁克首领，摆脱奥斯曼控制，一度统治埃及和叙利亚。

people.name: Murtada al-Zabidi
people.known_for: Scholar in Cairo who compiled the huge Arabic dictionary Taj al-Arus.
people.known_for_zh: 在开罗的学者，编成大型阿拉伯语词典《新娘的王冠》。

people.name: Mohammed ben Abdallah
people.known_for: Moroccan sultan who founded Essaouira and was the first ruler to recognise the United States.
people.known_for_zh: 摩洛哥苏丹，兴建索维拉港，是第一个承认美国的君主。

people.name: Murad Bey
people.known_for: Mamluk leader who fought Napoleon at the Battle of the Pyramids in 1798.
people.known_for_zh: 马穆鲁克首领，1798年在金字塔战役中与拿破仑交战。

people.name: Abd al-Rahman al-Jabarti
people.known_for: Historian who recorded the French occupation of Egypt as an eyewitness.
people.known_for_zh: 历史学家，亲历并记录了法国占领埃及。

people.name: Hammuda ibn Ali
people.known_for: Bey of Tunis whose long reign brought prosperity and independence from Algiers.
people.known_for_zh: 突尼斯贝伊，长期统治使突尼斯繁荣，并摆脱阿尔及尔的控制。

Egypt.name_zh: 埃及（穆罕默德·阿里王朝）

people.name: Muhammad Ali of Egypt
people.known_for: Albanian officer who seized power in Egypt and built a modern army, industry and schools.
people.known_for_zh: 阿尔巴尼亚裔军官，夺取埃及政权，建立近代化的军队、工业和学校。

people.name: Ibrahim Pasha
people.known_for: Son of Muhammad Ali who conquered Syria and twice defeated the Ottoman army.
people.known_for_zh: 穆罕默德·阿里之子，征服叙利亚，两次击败奥斯曼军队。

people.name: Antoine Clot
people.known_for: French physician who founded the first modern medical school in Egypt.
people.known_for_zh: 法国医生，创办了埃及第一所近代医学院。

people.name: Rifa'a al-Tahtawi
people.known_for: Scholar who described Paris for Egyptians and led the translation movement.
people.known_for_zh: 学者，向埃及人介绍巴黎见闻，主持翻译运动。

people.name: Ferdinand de Lesseps
people.known_for: French diplomat who organised the building of the Suez Canal, opened in 1869.
people.known_for_zh: 法国外交官，主持修建1869年通航的苏伊士运河。

people.name: Emir Abdelkader
people.known_for: Algerian leader who resisted the French conquest for fifteen years.
people.known_for_zh: 阿尔及利亚领袖，抵抗法国征服达十五年之久。

people.name: Ahmad I ibn Mustafa
people.known_for: Bey of Tunis who abolished slavery in 1846, before most of the world.
people.known_for_zh: 突尼斯贝伊，1846年废除奴隶制，早于世界上大多数国家。

people.name: Khayr al-Din Pasha
people.known_for: Reforming prime minister of Tunisia who wrote on how Muslim states could modernise.
people.known_for_zh: 突尼斯改革派首相，著书论述伊斯兰国家如何实现现代化。

people.name: Auguste Mariette
people.known_for: French Egyptologist who founded the Egyptian Museum and the antiquities service.
people.known_for_zh: 法国埃及学家，创建埃及博物馆和文物管理局。

people.name: Ali Mubarak
people.known_for: Engineer and minister who planned modern Cairo and its school system.
people.known_for_zh: 工程师和大臣，规划了近代开罗及其学校体系。

people.name: Isma'il Pasha
people.known_for: Khedive who opened the Suez Canal and rebuilt Cairo but left Egypt deep in debt.
people.known_for_zh: 赫迪夫，开通苏伊士运河，改建开罗，但使埃及负债累累。

people.name: Mahmoud Sami el-Baroudi
people.known_for: Poet who revived classical Arabic verse and led the government during the Urabi revolt.
people.known_for_zh: 复兴阿拉伯古典诗歌的诗人，在奥拉比起义期间出任首相。

people.name: Ahmed Urabi
people.known_for: Egyptian officer who led the national revolt of 1879 to 1882 against foreign control.
people.known_for_zh: 埃及军官，领导1879年至1882年反对外国控制的民族起义。

Egypt.name: Fuad I
Egypt.note: Sultan, then King of Egypt from 1922.
Egypt.note_zh: 先称苏丹，1922年起称埃及国王。

people.name: Evelyn Baring, 1st Earl of Cromer
people.known_for: British consul-general who ran Egypt in practice from 1883 to 1907.
people.known_for_zh: 英国驻埃及总领事，1883年至1907年实际掌控埃及。

people.name: Muhammad Abduh
people.known_for: Mufti of Egypt and leading thinker of Islamic modernism.
people.known_for_zh: 埃及大穆夫提，伊斯兰现代主义的主要思想家。

people.name: Omar Mukhtar
people.known_for: Teacher who led the Libyan resistance against Italy for twenty years.
people.known_for_zh: 教师出身，领导利比亚人抵抗意大利达二十年。

people.name: Saad Zaghloul
people.known_for: Leader of the Wafd party and the 1919 revolution for Egyptian independence.
people.known_for_zh: 华夫脱党领袖，领导争取埃及独立的1919年革命。

people.name: Qasim Amin
people.known_for: Jurist whose book The Liberation of Women began a debate on women's rights in Egypt.
people.known_for_zh: 法学家，他的《妇女的解放》引发了埃及关于妇女权利的讨论。

people.name: Ahmed Shawqi
people.known_for: Egyptian poet hailed as the Prince of Poets.
people.known_for_zh: 被誉为“诗王”的埃及诗人。

people.name: Howard Carter
people.known_for: British archaeologist who discovered the tomb of Tutankhamun in 1922.
people.known_for_zh: 英国考古学家，1922年发现图坦卡蒙墓。

people.name: Mustafa Kamil Pasha
people.known_for: Young nationalist leader who called for British withdrawal from Egypt.
people.known_for_zh: 年轻的民族主义领袖，要求英国撤出埃及。

people.name: Huda Sha'arawi
people.known_for: Founder of the Egyptian Feminist Union who publicly removed her veil in 1923.
people.known_for_zh: 埃及妇女联合会创始人，1923年当众揭去面纱。

people.name: Abd el-Krim
people.known_for: Leader of the Rif Republic who defeated Spain at Annual in 1921.
people.known_for_zh: 里夫共和国领袖，1921年在阿努瓦勒击败西班牙军。

people.name: Taha Hussein
people.known_for: Blind writer called the Dean of Arabic Literature, author of The Days.
people.known_for_zh: 双目失明的作家，被誉为“阿拉伯文学泰斗”，著有自传《日子》。

people.name: Abdelhamid Ben Badis
people.known_for: Algerian reformer who founded the Association of Muslim Ulema.
people.known_for_zh: 阿尔及利亚改革家，创建穆斯林乌理玛协会。

people.name: Mahmoud Mokhtar
people.known_for: Sculptor of Egypt's Awakening, father of modern Egyptian sculpture.
people.known_for_zh: 雕塑家，作品《埃及的复兴》，被视为埃及现代雕塑之父。

people.name: Sayed Darwish
people.known_for: Composer who created modern Egyptian popular music and the national anthem's melody.
people.known_for_zh: 作曲家，开创了埃及现代流行音乐，埃及国歌的曲调出自他手。

people.name: Messali Hadj
people.known_for: Founder of the Algerian independence movement.
people.known_for_zh: 阿尔及利亚独立运动的创始人。

people.name: Tawfiq al-Hakim
people.known_for: Founder of modern Arabic drama.
people.known_for_zh: 现代阿拉伯戏剧的奠基人。

people.name: Hassan al-Banna
people.known_for: Teacher who founded the Muslim Brotherhood in 1928.
people.known_for_zh: 教师，1928年创立穆斯林兄弟会。

people.name: Aboul-Qacem Echebbi
people.known_for: Tunisian poet whose lines "If the people one day wish to live" are in Tunisia's anthem.
people.known_for_zh: 突尼斯诗人，他的诗句“人民一旦渴望生活”写入了突尼斯国歌。

Egypt.name: Gamal Abdel Nasser
Egypt.name_zh: 贾迈勒·阿卜杜勒·纳赛尔

Egypt.name: Mohamed Hussein Tantawi
Egypt.name_zh: 穆罕默德·侯赛因·坦塔维

Algeria.name: Abdelaziz Bouteflika
Algeria.name_zh: 阿卜杜勒阿齐兹·布特弗利卡

Morocco.name: Mohammed V
Morocco.note: Sultan under the French protectorate until 1956, king from 1957.
Morocco.note_zh: 1956年以前为法国保护下的苏丹，1957年起称国王。

people.name: Gamal Abdel Nasser
people.name_zh: 贾迈勒·阿卜杜勒·纳赛尔
people.known_for: Egyptian president who nationalised the Suez Canal and led Arab nationalism.
people.known_for_zh: 埃及总统，把苏伊士运河收归国有，是阿拉伯民族主义的旗手。

people.name: Anwar Sadat
people.known_for: President who launched the 1973 war, then made peace with Israel and was assassinated.
people.known_for_zh: 发动1973年战争、后与以色列媾和的埃及总统，后遇刺身亡。

people.name: Mohammed V of Morocco
people.known_for: Sultan exiled by France who returned to lead Morocco to independence in 1956.
people.known_for_zh: 曾被法国流放的苏丹，回国后领导摩洛哥于1956年独立。

people.name: Habib Bourguiba
people.known_for: Leader of Tunisian independence and first president, who expanded women's rights.
people.known_for_zh: 领导突尼斯独立的首任总统，大力推进妇女权利。

people.name: Umm Kulthum
people.known_for: Egyptian singer, the most celebrated voice of the Arab world.
people.known_for_zh: 埃及歌唱家，阿拉伯世界最负盛名的歌手。

people.name: Hassan Fathy
people.known_for: Architect who revived mud-brick building for the poor at New Gourna.
people.known_for_zh: 建筑师，在新古尔纳村为穷人复兴传统泥砖建筑。

people.name: Sayyid Qutb
people.known_for: Muslim Brotherhood thinker executed under Nasser, whose writings inspired Islamist movements.
people.known_for_zh: 穆斯林兄弟会思想家，在纳赛尔时期被处死，他的著作影响了伊斯兰主义运动。

people.name: Naguib Mahfouz
people.known_for: Egyptian novelist of the Cairo Trilogy, Nobel Prize in Literature 1988.
people.known_for_zh: 埃及小说家，著有“开罗三部曲”，1988年获诺贝尔文学奖。

people.name: Ahmed Ben Bella
people.known_for: Leader of the Algerian independence war and first president of Algeria.
people.known_for_zh: 阿尔及利亚独立战争领导人和首任总统。

people.name: Boutros Boutros-Ghali
people.name_zh: 布特罗斯·布特罗斯-加利
people.known_for: Egyptian diplomat who served as Secretary-General of the United Nations.
people.known_for_zh: 埃及外交家，曾任联合国秘书长。

people.name: Frantz Fanon
people.known_for: Psychiatrist who joined the Algerian revolution and wrote The Wretched of the Earth.
people.known_for_zh: 参加阿尔及利亚革命的精神科医生，著有《全世界受苦的人》。

people.name: Youssef Chahine
people.known_for: Leading Egyptian film director.
people.known_for_zh: 埃及最重要的电影导演。

people.name: Hosni Mubarak
people.known_for: President of Egypt for thirty years, overthrown in the 2011 revolution.
people.known_for_zh: 执政三十年的埃及总统，在2011年革命中下台。

people.name: Hassan II of Morocco
people.known_for: King of Morocco who led the Green March into Western Sahara in 1975.
people.known_for_zh: 摩洛哥国王，1975年发起进入西撒哈拉的“绿色进军”。

people.name: Abdel Halim Hafez
people.name_zh: 阿卜杜勒·哈利姆·哈菲兹
people.known_for: Egyptian singer and actor known as the Dark-skinned Nightingale.
people.known_for_zh: 埃及歌手和演员，人称“棕色夜莺”。

people.name: Kateb Yacine
people.known_for: Algerian writer whose novel Nedjma is a classic of North African literature.
people.known_for_zh: 阿尔及利亚作家，他的小说《娜吉玛》是北非文学经典。

people.name: Nawal El Saadawi
people.known_for: Egyptian doctor and feminist writer.
people.known_for_zh: 埃及医生和女性主义作家。

people.name: Houari Boumediene
people.known_for: Algerian president who nationalised oil and championed the Third World.
people.known_for_zh: 阿尔及利亚总统，实行石油国有化，倡导第三世界团结。

people.name: Omar Sharif
people.known_for: Egyptian actor who starred in Lawrence of Arabia and Doctor Zhivago.
people.known_for_zh: 埃及演员，主演《阿拉伯的劳伦斯》和《日瓦戈医生》。

people.name: Mohammed Abed al-Jabri
people.known_for: Moroccan philosopher known for his Critique of Arab Reason.
people.known_for_zh: 摩洛哥哲学家，以《阿拉伯理性批判》著称。

people.name: Mohamed Choukri
people.known_for: Moroccan writer of the autobiographical novel For Bread Alone.
people.known_for_zh: 摩洛哥作家，著有自传体小说《裸面包》。

people.name: Assia Djebar
people.known_for: Algerian novelist and film-maker, the first Maghrebi member of the Académie française.
people.known_for_zh: 阿尔及利亚小说家和电影导演，第一位入选法兰西学术院的马格里布人。

people.name: Muammar Gaddafi
people.known_for: Officer who seized power in Libya in 1969 and ruled until killed in 2011.
people.known_for_zh: 1969年夺取利比亚政权的军官，统治至2011年被杀。
